items.title: Chess.com’s next move is a new hub for classic games, from mahjong to sudoku
items.rawSummary:
Chess.com is ready to go a lot bigger than chess. After launching Gambit, a gambling-free poker site, earlier this year, the company is now adding 10 more games: backgammon, checkers, go, hearts, mahjong, shogi, sudoku, solitaire, xiangqi, and a Scrabble alternative called word. They're all part of Chess's new Classic Games platform, which is launching its public beta on Saturday on the web and through a new app for iOS and Android.

items.title: Cut self-hosted LLM cost and latency with the distributed KV caching agent skill
items.rawSummary: Self-hosting LLMs on GPUs means paying to recompute the same context on every turn. Distributed KV caching with Amazon ElastiCache can cut inference cost by up to 40% and time to first token by up to 80%. This post walks through the distributed KV caching skill in the Agent Toolkit for AWS, which evaluates and sets up the cache from your coding agent.
